_note: Shared content for the Golden Shell (the same for every hunter). Fragments are written for the vault at 26380, 66, -23633 (squares: 16,384 at 16384,-32768; 4,096 at 24576,-24576; 1,024 at 25600,-24576) and the key 2 5 7 3. Upload with scripts/hunt/seed.js --content or paste into /hunt/admin/.

chapters.title: The Impostor
chapters.clue: Nine treasures, described in my own hand. Eight are honest. Find the liar, then let each honest one give up a single letter.
hints: My descriptions use the same words as the library's rare pages.
Filter by category and release month first. Most descriptions then leave one or two rares.
The number is a letter position in the rare's name (count letters only). One description fits no rare at all: skip it.
chapters.fragment: Where the map runs out on two sides.

chapters.title: Same Bones
chapters.clue: Beneath every treasure is something ordinary. Four of mine share the same bones. Ask the library what else is built on them.
hints: The library can show every rare made from the same thing.
The four share one vanilla base item. Use the rare library's Base item filter.
Filter by that base item and sort A to Z. The numbers are positions; take first letters.

chapters.title: Cross Yourself
chapters.clue: Hold the hour in your hand, then cross yourself.
hints: The mod can show a page for whatever is in your hand.
Hold a clock. Press the key that crosses and the key that stands alone.
X and I. Each note names your next item in a riddle.

chapters.title: Daily Bread
chapters.clue: I play the daily game too, but never on your board. Beat my boards, and their first letters will speak.
hints: The daily rare game has a hunter's mode.
Once you're signed up, Rare-dle has a Hunt boards button.
Win every board and read the answers' first letters.
chapters.fragment: A great white island rests in it.

chapters.title: Strange Prices
chapters.clue: A merchant sells what nobody wants, at prices nobody would pay. Every coin is a letter.
hints: I keep shops on both worlds, and the trading post lists everything.
Search for my junk, one world at a time.
Diamonds are letters. 1 is A.
chapters.fragment: On the eastern edge of your square.

chapters.title: The Ghost Above the Chest
chapters.clue: Ask the ghost above my chests how many remain. Count up from the poorest, and listen to what each one whispers to you.
hints: The ghost is the number the mod floats on a shop chest. It may be switched off in your settings.
Visit my shop on Firefly. Each ghost whispers one letter, to you alone.
Order the letters by stock, smallest first.
chapters.fragment: Neither the first nor the last of its column.

chapters.title: Days Gone By
chapters.clue: The market remembers every day. I asked it five questions about days gone by. Now you ask them.
hints: Every item page remembers its prices.
Look at each item's lowest price on the day I name.
The cheapest of each group wins. The number is a letter of its name (count letters only).

chapters.title: Wanted: A Reader
chapters.clue: I'm hiring. The pay is terrible. The job description is the job.
hints: The marketplace has jobs, and I've posted one.
Apply for my job. I answer every applicant.
Shift each letter of the code back by your numbers.
chapters.fragment: Due east of where the white island ends.

chapters.title: The Torn Corner
chapters.clue: I tore a corner off my map and turned it in my hands. Put it back, and tell me its region.
hints: My map is the one of Firefly.
It's turned in my hands. Match coastlines and rivers, and use the arrows to look around.
Find where it fits, hover its very middle and give me the Region the map shows.

chapters.title: The Gallery
chapters.clue: Art hangs in rows. I remember five pieces, but not their names. Find them, and let each name give you a letter.
hints: The catalog knows every artist.
Filter by artist and category, then check the size.
The number is a letter position in the title.

chapters.title: The Shelf
chapters.clue: I keep a collection like everyone else. What I keep is not what I want.
hints: I have a profile, like you. So does my collection.
H is what I have, W is what I want.
Line each list up A to Z. H3 is the third thing I have; take its first letter.
chapters.fragment: Not cut short by the end of the map.

chapters.title: Doors Without Signs
chapters.clue: Some doors on my site have no signs. One is named after the lights of the night, and opens only while they're out, and only for you.
hints: Not every page on sctp.nl has a link to it.
Try the door named after the insects of the night.
sctp.nl/fireflies, between 20:00 and 23:00 your time, logged in.
chapters.fragment: A pink island with red spots touches its southern edge.

chapters.title: Wings for Coin
chapters.clue: Where wings are traded for coin, I left you a note. Count what's for sale before you read it.
hints: Wings are traded at the garden.
Open the Butterfly Exchange. My note sits above it.
Count the kinds of butterfly for sale. That's your step: read the first letter, then every that-many-th letter after it.
chapters.fragment: The first arrow points straight to the right.

chapters.title: The Watchful Eye
chapters.clue: Keep an eye on what nobody wants. I notice who's watching.
hints: The mod can watch items for you and tell you when they show up.
Add my junk to your watchlist, then look at your watchlist.
Watch the dead bush. My note sits in the corner of the mod's Watchlist screen.
chapters.fragment: The second arrow points down and to the left.

chapters.title: Ask the Ledger
chapters.clue: Your game keeps a ledger of every shop on the server. Ask it for me by name.
hints: The mod can search every listing without leaving the game.
Open the mod (X) and search for me.
Type Shellkeeper in the mod's search box. My note sits in the corner.
chapters.fragment: The third arrow is one click short of pointing up again.

chapters.title: Two Worlds
chapters.clue: Half my word waits where the fireflies glow, the other half where the bees hum. Ask your own front page in each.
hints: Fireflies and bees are worlds, not insects.
Open the mod's home screen (X) on Firefly, then again on Honeybee.
My note sits in the corner of the home screen. Firefly holds the first half.
chapters.fragment: The fourth arrow points down and to the right.

whorls.title: The Archive
whorls.intro: The Shellkeeper's own records: the rares, what they're made of, and the game of guessing them.
whorls.puzzle: Each fragment rules squares out. Which square of the world is left?
whorls.nudge: Cross squares off on the world map as you read each fragment. North is up.

whorls.title: The Market
whorls.intro: Shops on both worlds, their ghosts, their history and their jobs.
whorls.puzzle: Your first square splits into sixteen. Only one is meant.
whorls.nudge: North is up, east is right. The white island is the big snowy one from Whorl I.

whorls.title: The Atlas
whorls.intro: Maps, art, collections and doors nobody links to.
whorls.puzzle: The last square: as close as the map will go.
whorls.nudge: The map cuts off near the eastern edge: a square cut short is only partly drawn.

whorls.title: The Garden
whorls.intro: Out into your own game: the garden, the mod's watchful eye, its ledger and your own pockets.
whorls.puzzle: Four frames, each holding an arrow that starts pointing up. Every click turns an arrow an eighth of the way round, clockwise. How many clicks does each frame need?
whorls.nudge: Pointing right is two clicks. Pointing down is four.
